The '''showman''' (Japanese: '''座長''' ''ringmaster'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN098|Out of Their Elements!]]''.

The showman is the owner of a Pokémon circus that visited [[Vermilion City]]. He met {{Ash}}, [[Goh]], and [[Chloe]] who visited his circus. Before a performance, two of his performers accidentally had their {{p|Eevee}} evolve into {{p|Jolteon}} and {{p|Flareon}} which they'd planned to do during their upcoming performance.

After {{OBP|Harmony|JN098}} and {{OBP|Billy|JN098}} were able come up with a new routine with their Pokémon, the performance went ahead with Ash, Goh, and Chloe taking part.

* The showman bears a resemblance to the {{OBP|leader|JN014}}, who appeared in ''[[JN014|Raid Battle in The Ruins!]]'', and the [[curator]], who appeared in ''[[JN038|Restore and Renew!]]''. This fact was mentioned by {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] in the episode. They also share the same Japanese, {{pmin|English|English}}, {{pmin|Italy|Italian}} and {{pmin|Poland|Polish}} voice actors.
